## CL++ VM 0.11.1

Candidate release notes. Publication follows platform and artifact validation.

- Omitted optional fields default to null. Optional presence checks consistently reject null and false, while retaining zero and empty strings.
- Postfix `value:is<Type>` supports runtime type checks and narrowing for reified types, with method completion/highlighting.
- Object initializer completion handles imported definitions, inheritance and generics; hover and navigation identify the declaring field.
- Editor refactoring rejects invalid identifiers, collisions and captures, preserves document versions and rejects malformed edit batches. Unresolved names no longer acquire another variable's references.
- External method declarations distinguish their owner type from the method in fallback highlighting.
- Expanded formatter, recovery, adversarial and package validation is permanent in CI.

The serialized bytecode version is 13. Recompile previously generated bytecode with this compiler.

Rename/references remain limited to current-document variables and parameters. Cancellation does not interrupt an analysis already running. Package APIs and the independent Luau compiler retain their separate scope.
